import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static final int N = 1 << 20;

    static int fpow(int x, int y) {
        int ret = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) ret = (int) ((long) ret * x % mod);
            x = (int) ((long) x * x % mod);
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    static int M = 21;

    static int n;
    static int[] f = new int[N];
    static int[] g = new int[N];
    static double[][] p = new double[M][M];

    static int[][] idx = new int[2][N];
    static int[] rev = new int[N];
    static int[] matched = new int[M];
    static boolean[][] adj = new boolean[M][M];

    static void work(int[] f, int[] l, int[] r, int[] subgraph, int[] idx) {
        List<Pair> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int x : l) {
            for (int y : r) {
                edges.add(new Pair(x, y));
            }
        }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << edges.size()); ++mask) {
            double rate = 1;
            int newmask = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < edges.size(); ++i) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    rate *= p[edges.get(i).x][edges.get(i).y];
                    adj[edges.get(i).x][edges.get(i).y] = true;
                } else {
                    rate *= (1 - p[edges.get(i).x][edges.get(i).y]);
                    adj[edges.get(i).x][edges.get(i).y] = false;
                }
                rate = (rate + mod) % mod;
            }

            for (int gr : subgraph) {
                List<Integer> perm = new ArrayList<>();
                List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int x : l) perm.add(x);
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) if ((gr & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    indices.add(i + n);
                }

                boolean flag = false;
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int i = 0; i < perm.size(); ++i) {
                        if (!adj[perm.get(i)][indices.get(i)]) ok = false;
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        flag = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(indices));
                if (flag) newmask |= (1 << idx[gr]);
            }
            f[newmask] += (int) (rate % mod);
            f[newmask] %= mod;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String[] line = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                p[i][j + n] = Double.parseDouble(line[j]) * fpow(100, mod - 2) % mod;
            }
        }

        if (n == 1) {
            pw.println(p[0][1]);
            pw.close();
            return;
        }

        int m1 = n / 2;
        int m2 = n - m1;

        int cnt = 0, cnt2 = 0;
        List<Integer> sub1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> sub2 = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == m1) {
                idx[0][mask] = cnt++;
                sub1.add(mask);
            }
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == m2) {
                idx[1][mask] = cnt2++;
                sub2.add(mask);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < sub2.size(); ++i) {
            int mask = sub2.get(i);
            for (int bigmask = 0; bigmask < (1 << cnt2); ++bigmask) {
                if ((bigmask & (1 << i)) != 0) rev[bigmask] |= (1 << idx[0][(1 << n) - 1 - mask]);
            }
        }

        int[] l1 = new int[m1];
        int[] l2 = new int[m2];
        int[] r = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) r[i] = i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m1; ++i) l1[i] = i;
        for (int i = m1; i < n; ++i) l2[i - m1] = i;

        work(f, l1, r, sub1, idx[0]);
        work(g, l2, r, sub2, idx[1]);

        for (int i = 0; i < cnt; ++i) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << cnt); ++mask) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    f[mask] += f[mask ^ (1 << i)];
                    f[mask] %= mod;
                }
            }
        }

        long long ans = 0;

        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << cnt2); ++mask) {
            int w = (int) ((1 - f[(1 << cnt) - 1 - rev[mask]] + mod) % mod);
            ans += (w * g[mask]) % mod;
            ans %= mod;
        }

        pw.println(ans);

        pw.close();
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> list) {
        int i = list.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && list.get(i) >= list.get(i + 1)) --i;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = list.size() - 1;
        while (list.get(j) <= list.get(i)) --j;
        Collections.swap(list, i, j);
        Collections.reverse(list.subList(i + 1, list.size()));
        return true;
    }

    static class Pair {
        int x, y;

        public Pair(int x, int y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }
    }
